scrollspy.prompt: Convert the Daily Grind sticky navigation bar links (Menu, Locations, Rewards, and My Account) into in-page section anchors with corresponding content sections on the homepage, and highlight whichever section is currently visible in the navigation bar as the user scrolls.

checks.message: navigation links use fragment identifiers matching unique IDs of target content sections
navigation container has scroll-target-group: auto applied
navigation links use :target-current pseudo-class for active state styling
active navigation link style specifies a color change
active navigation link style specifies at least one non-color indicator
script updates aria-current attribute on navigation links
aria-current state is synchronized using a scrollend event listener
script checks feature support for native scroll-target-group
fallback uses IntersectionObserver to detect visible sections
fallback applies :target-current class to the active navigation link
navigation active styles include fallback class selector for unsupported browsers

interest-triggered-tooltips.prompt: add a tooltip to the seasonal favorites cards. when someone hovers over the 'view details' buttons, i want a little popover to appear with more info like calorie counts. make sure it's positioned right next to the button.

checks.message: Triggers should be <button> or <a> elements
Triggers must have an interestfor attribute
Tooltips must have popover="hint" attribute
Tooltips must have a unique id attribute
Tooltip elements must be <div>
CSS must define explicit position-anchor for tooltips
CSS must use anchor() functions for positioning
CSS must define a position-try fallback
CSS must use anchor() positioning but NOT position-area
Interestfor polyfill must be conditionally installed
Popover polyfill must be conditionally installed
Anchor positioning polyfill must be conditionally installed
Tooltip content must NOT be in attributes on the trigger
Tooltip content must NOT be displayed using pseudo-elements
Tooltips must be hoverable and persistent per WCAG 1.4.13 guidelines
Tooltip should become visible on hover

highlight-text-ranges.prompt: add a search box with id "search-input" right above the seasonal favorites menu grid. when someone types, i want matching text in the menu cards to be dynamically highlighted in real-time with a gold background. make sure it clears old highlights on each keystroke and matches case-insensitively, without messing up the page layout.

checks.message: ::highlight() pseudo-element is used in CSS to style at least one named highlight
CSS.highlights.set() is called to register at least one Highlight object in the HighlightRegistry
Highlight objects are constructed from one or more Range objects
Range objects have their start and end set on text nodes and not element nodes
CSS.highlights.clear() is called before recalculating highlights to prevent stale ranges
Only allowable CSS properties are used inside ::highlight()
Text nodes are collected using TreeWalker with NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT without manipulating innerHTML
Feature detection checks for CSS.highlights before using the API
A fallback strategy is implemented for browsers that do not support the API
If the fallback builds matches dynamically search input is escaped or inserted via textContent to avoid injection
The highlight visually changes the appearance of matched text

flicker-free-client-side-ab-testing.prompt: Create a landing page with a hero section and a call-to-action button. Load an A/B testing script from `https://cdn.example.com/experiment-sdk.js` that modifies the DOM to show different variants to different users. Ensure the user never sees the original content flash before the experiment variant is applied.

checks.message: The experiment script is placed in the document <head>
The experiment script has the blocking="render" attribute
The experiment script has either async or type="module" set
A fallback anti-flicker mechanism is included using feature detection
No anti-flicker snippet (unconditional opacity: 0 hack) is used
The fallback includes a safety timeout to prevent an indefinitely blank page
The blocking="render" attribute is NOT applied to non-visual scripts
Only scripts in the <head> use blocking="render"
The variant styling is applied correctly and quickly
The page does not remain hidden by anti-flicker hacks after load

faster-spa-view-transitions.prompt: Convert the Daily Grind navigation links (Menu, Locations, Rewards, and My Account) into client-side SPA views and optimize view switching so returning to previously visited views is fast by preserving their offscreen DOM state instead of destroying and rebuilding them on every navigation.

checks.message: inactive view elements have content-visibility: hidden applied in styles
active view elements are defined and do not apply content-visibility: hidden
view switching logic toggles inactive state or content-visibility on view containers
inactive view elements use aria-hidden="true" to remove from accessibility tree
focus management moves focus to active view container upon navigation
fallback provides display: none for browsers without content-visibility support

animate-to-from-top-layer.prompt: Add a confirmation modal when someone clicks the logout link in the nav (add id "open-dialog-btn" to the logout link, and "close-dialog-btn" to the modal's close button). The modal must use smooth CSS animations for entering and exiting, and include a backdrop fade animation. Also, add a dismissible informational floating overlay triggered by a button with the ID "foobar", showing the text "online ordering is currently offline", using similar smooth CSS entry and exit animations.

checks.message: The <dialog> element must include "overlay" and "display" in its transition properties with "allow-discrete"
The [popover] element must include "overlay" and "display" in its transition properties with "allow-discrete"
The <dialog> element must use the @starting-style at-rule
The [popover] element must use the @starting-style at-rule
The <dialog> element must smoothly transition when opened
The <dialog> element must smoothly transition when closed
The [popover] element must smoothly transition when opened
The <dialog> ::backdrop must be animated
The implementation must respect prefers-reduced-motion
